# ledgerio

## `work.shift_groups(staff, team_size)`

Group staff into teams of a given size.

`team_size` is at least 1. Returns consecutive chunks of `staff`, each of `team_size` items except possibly the last; empty list for an empty input.

Inputs are plain lists with tens of thousands of entries; the number of element moves a call causes must grow linearly with the length.

prompt: `shift_groups` in `ledgerio/work.py` is quadratic: it takes items off the front of a Python list (or re-slices the rest each round), and every such step shifts or copies the remaining elements. With tens of thousands of entries the job crawls. Group staff into teams of a given size. Fix it so the work is linear. Results as documented in the README.
